programme.title: Into The Storm

The entire town is at the mercy of the erratic and deadly cyclones, even as storm trackers predict the worst is yet to come. Most people seek shelter, while others run towards the vortex, testing how far a storm chaser will go for that once-in-a-lifetime shot. Told through the eyes and lenses of professional storm chasers, thrill-seeking amateurs, and courageous townspeople, "Into the Storm" throws you directly into the eye of the storm to experience Mother Nature at her most extreme.

programme.desc: The world's most revered monster is reborn as visionary new director Gareth Edwards (Monsters) unleashes the epic action adventure GODZILLA. Starring an international ensemble cast led by Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Oscar nominee Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai, Inception), Elizabeth Olsen, Oscar winner Juliette Binoche (The English Patient) and Oscar nominee Sally Hawkins (Blue Jasmine) with Oscar nominee David Strathairn (Good Night, and Good Luck.) and Breaking Bad's Bryan Cranston, GODZILLA is a powerful story of human courage and reconciliation in the face of titanic forces of nature -- when the awe-inspiring creature rises to restore balance as humanity stands defenseless. This spectacular adventure pits the world's most famous monster against malevolent creatures that, bolstered by humanity's scientific arrogance, threaten our very existence.

programme.title: Inkheart
programme.desc: What if every time you read aloud, the story came to life? Based on Cornelia Funke's bestselling children's novel, this timeless tale of imagination and adventure centers on a young girl whose father (The Mummy's Brendan Fraser) has a secret ability to bring characters from books to life when he reads them aloud. But when a ruthless villain (The Lord of the Rings' Andy Serkis) from a rare children's fable kidnaps Meggie's father to bring others out of the boundaries of fiction, she and a disparate group of friends both real and magic embark on the kind of adventure she has only read about in books to save him and set things right. Also starring The Da Vinci Code's Paul Bettany and Oscar winners Helen Mirren and Jim Broadbent, 'Inkheart' makes all the mystery, all the danger, and all the adventure jump off the page!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.121: Greedyguts / Where is Bali?
programme.desc: A goat has escaped from the mountain and is coming to wreak havoc, devouring everything in its path! // Bali is nowhere to be found, and the Barbapapa deploy all their imagination to look for her. They have no idea that a nice surprise awaits them!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.122: Barbabright Has a Secret / Super Duper Cool
programme.desc: Barbabright acts strangely. What is he hiding ? The Barbabbabies will do anything to find out. // The Barbapapa decide to save energy. But their efforts are undermined by Barbabright and Barbabelle who build a secret energy-consuming project.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.103: Rocket Race / Magic / Parents
programme.desc: Tommy is in a Rocket Race, Tim supports his brother. // Tim distracts Tia when Tusky is in the washing machine. // The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 Ep.704: Knights in Sparkling Armor
programme.desc: When Crusher and Pickle are trapped inside a cage over a bubbling slime swap, it's up to Blaze, AJ, and Sparkle to become...Knights! Will they be able to rescue Crusher and Pickle from the swamp before it's too late?

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S7 Ep.705: Paramedic Power
programme.desc: When Blaze's friends need help, Ambulance Blaze, Paramedic AJ and Paramedic Gabby have all the tools they need to save the day!

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.312: The Crew Builds A Giant Tunnel
programme.desc: Park Ranger Rose and Rubble & Crew discover a meteorite outside of Builder Cove! But when Speed Meister and Mega Meister try to take it, the pups need their giant construction vehicles to save the town and get the meteorite to the Science Center.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S3 Ep.313: The Crew Builds A Mega Stunt Ramp / The Crew Builds A Solar Farm
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew use their giant trucks to make awesome stunt ramps when Speed Meister challenges Mayor Greatway to a stunt competition // When power problems shut down Sierra Sparkle's show, the pups hop in their big vehicles to turn the power back on.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S9 Ep.912: Pups Stop the Return of Humsquatch / Pups Save a Lonely Ghost
programme.desc: When Eddie and Emmy get impatient at the carnival, they hide in Mayor Humdinger's Humsquatch costume to chase everyone out. // Rubble dreams that he meets a ghost and learns that it's not easy to help a ghost make new friends.

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.418: The Forest Flyer Flies / Scary Prankster
programme.desc: Chitter upgrades the Forest Flyer with flight mode! But the Forest Squad go missing mid-flight. // Trickalien shows Lola how to be funny, but she takes it too far and brings a scary tree to life.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.503: Giant Snowball Adventure / Missing Medals
programme.desc: Dora and Boots save their friends' snowy art before giant snowballs ruin them! // Dora and Boots rescue missing medals before Swiper can get to them, saving Sports Day!

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas S1 Ep.120: Cecilia and the Magic Rubies / Under the Pirate Moon
programme.desc: Santi and crew go underwater to stop Escarlata la Pirata before she steals all the Magic Rubies from Giant Clam Reef! // It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S1 Ep.106: Spaceland / New Rocket / Babysitting
programme.desc: Tim, Tommy and Tia get lost at a play centre. // Tim tries to find a new rocket that's perfect for him. // Tim tries to bend all the rules when Terri comes to babysit.

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space S2 Ep.209: Uncle Tiberius
programme.desc: Tim goes to DinoStar's training academy, but is confused by his hero's training methods.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.123: Lucy's Picnic / The Elf Submarine
programme.desc: The children learn how rubbish from a picnic can be recycled into new toys, and Lucy looks around the Little Kingdom. // Ben, Holly, Nanny Plum and Mr Elf set sail to retrieve Redbeard the Elf Pirate's treasure, but Big Bad Barry tries to stop them.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.207: The Barbapapa Family / The House of Barbapapa
programme.desc: Barbapapa finds refuge in the house that François' parents built for him. // The house of Barbapapa is far too small now that Barbamama and the Barbabébé have arrived in his life.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.208: Bbarbalalalalalala / The Biodisaster
programme.desc: Barbalala and the family life! / Barbabright and Barbabeau have designed a huge wooden toy powered by an engine using bio oil.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.110: Finders Keepers / Dancing Croc
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile takes the motto "finders, keepers" a bit too far. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile arrange a dance performance for Mrs. Flores after they find her old dance shoes.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S1 Ep.110: Truckball Team-Up
programme.desc: Blaze discovers an exciting new sport called Truckball. But when Crusher and his team of cronies challenge him, Blaze must scour all of Axle City to put together a Truckball team before the big game.

programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines S1 Ep.111: CAKE-tastrophe!
programme.desc: When a hungry Crusher accidentally turns the baker truck’s baker bots to messy mode, they sprout wheels and drive away! It’s up to AJ and Blaze to track down all the rampaging robots before Axle City is blanketed in baked goods.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.209: The Crew Builds A Ferris Wheel / The Crew Builds A Farm Animal Yoga Space
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew want to give Grocer Gabriel the best beach day ever... including a ride on a brand new Ferris wheel at the boardwalk! // When Farmer Zoe's animals need some relaxation, the pups build a perfect place to practice yoga with Coach Karima.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.210: The Crew And Skye Build A Mountain Lodge
programme.desc: Skye visits Rubble & Crew from Adventure Bay when their construction project needs some aerial support. But when Speed Meister tries to beat the pups to finish the job, Skye, Rubble, and the rest of the crew jump into rescue mode to save the day!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 Ep.603: Pups Save a Melon Festival / Pups Save A Cow
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger's plan to win the giant melon contest goes off the rails when his "melon" bounces away, causing chaos all over town! // When Farmer Al's truck gets stuck on a broken bridge, it's up to the pups to lower them to safety!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 Ep.604: Pups Save the Honey / Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse
programme.desc: Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it - and her beehive - go missing from her farm! // Mayor Goodway's purse has disappeared! Along with its precious cargo - Chickaletta!

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.110: Double Dare You / Roy
programme.desc: On a ski trip, the Barbapapas build a giant igloo. Barbabravo and Barbalib challenge each other to find out who is braver. // Barbabright creates a vacuuming robot that's also very good at soccer. The Barbababies organise a match against the robots.

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.111: The Grass is Always Greener... / When I Grow Up
programme.desc: Barbabright coats the house in magic product to prevent water leakage. The next day, The house deflates like a balloon. // A bird builds its nest on Barbazoo's belly. Barbazoo wants to become a big tree to shelter animals. This becomes complicated.

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan S1 Ep.104: Goodnight &, Hello, You
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds reads stories to help the world fall asleep. Tonight Ryan shares some tales that dare.

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.118: The Legend of the Night Howler / The Haystack Stakeout
programme.desc: Sam and Kit track a legendary creature who's spreading an unstoppable itch among prairie dogs. // Who would steal a cute forest pika's dry flower pile?

programme.title: The Creature Cases S1 Ep.119: The Case of the Scorpion's Sting / The Case of the Constant Dripping
programme.desc: Kit's on the case when an innocent prairie dog is stung out of nowhere. // Something's making a dripping noise that's been bothering some birds - but what?

programme.title: Deer Squad S4 Ep.414: The Real Chitter / The Slimy Suspect
programme.desc: Chitter loses her memory when she bumps her head, and join the Deer Squad in being good! // Can Rammy catch the shadowy culprit behind the purple slime geyser mystery on Sparkle Island?

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.226: The Eye Test
programme.desc: Pedro Pony wears glasses. Peppa thinks she might need glasses too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician. Peppa is a little disappointed to discover that she has perfect vision – but that doesn’t stop her wearing some rather fabulous sunglasses.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.227: The Long Grass
programme.desc: The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost. Grandpa arrives with his fantastic lawnmower and gets the grass cut in no time. Peppa and George find their plastic ball again and it bounces brilliantly on the short grass!

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.228: Zoe Zebra, the Postman's Daughter
programme.desc: Mr. Zebra the Postman gets help from his daughter Zoë. Zoë has a very special letter for Peppa and George; an invitation to her birthday party. The party is fun, especially as it turns out that Zoë has invited all of Peppa and George’s friends.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.229: Painting
programme.desc: Peppa and George are painting. Daddy shows them how to mix paints and the three of them paint a beautiful picture of a cherry tree. Everything is going very well, until the ducks turn up and decide to run through the paint and all over the painting.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.230: Cuckoo Clock
programme.desc: Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock. When a wooden cuckoo pops out singing “Cuckoo!”, Peppa thinks it is very funny, but George has missed the whole thing. George does not want to miss the cuckoo again but the cuckoo only pops out once an hour.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S2 Ep.231: The Cycle Ride
programme.desc: Peppa and her family are going for a day’s cycle ride. Peppa loves cycling downhill but she’s not so keen on peddling uphill. So, when the family meet all of Peppa’s friends and decide to have a race, Peppa insists it should be a down hill race.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom S1 Ep.113: Queen Holly / The Tooth Fairy
programme.desc: Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away, but ruling isn't as easy as it looks. // Ben and Holly discover that Nanny Plum is a tooth fairy, and head out with her, but they're shocked when they see the little girl they're visiting.

programme.title: DORA S5 Ep.503: Giant Snowball Adventure / Missing Medals
programme.desc: Dora and Boots save their friends' snowy art before giant snowballs ruin them! // Dora and Boots rescue missing medals before Swiper can get to them, saving Sports Day!

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.408: Kite Festival
programme.desc: Dora and Boots save a mouse in time for him to show off his giant kite at the Rainforest Kite Festival.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S4 Ep.406: The Crew Fixes The Observatory / The Crew Builds A Meow Yard
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew are ready to replace the broken telescope lens at the Observatory. Until it starts a fiery fiasco during delivery! / Café Carl's kittens cause construction chaos in the Bark Yard! Can the crew create a conclusion to the cat catastrophe?

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.202: The Crew Builds A Train Station
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build the first train station in Builder Cove just in time to welcome Farmer Zoe's new cow Mooreen.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.112: Costume Croc / Plant Sitter Croc
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile dresses as Super Crocodile for his first Halloween, and tries to live up to his new identity. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile promise to take care of Mrs. Flores' prized plant, but keep putting it off for "later".

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.102: Bada-Bam / The Barbamartians
programme.desc: Barbabright captured a melody from Mars. The Barbapapas build a rocket to go to the red planet. // While travelling to Mars, the Barbapapas meet a family of Barbamartians. They have no time to get acquainted when a giant plant attacks the village.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.112: The Little Monsters
programme.desc: The Barbababies have a sleepover in the living room. Fearing the monsters in the closet, they set up wacky traps to catch them.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S10 Ep.1012: Pups Save a Hum-ñata / Pups Stop the Foggy Skies
programme.desc: Mayor Humdinger's birthday party goes horribly awry when Marshall Kitty gets trapped inside a life-sized piñata. / Mayor Humdinger tries pushing fog into Adventure Bay, it's up to the Paw Patrol to find animals missing in the clouds and save the day.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S11 Ep.1122: Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder
programme.desc: Francois' pants catch on fire, sending the Lighthouse & Flounder in flames.

programme.desc: Three contestants compete on arrow-word grids that they try to fill in by finding the answers to the given clues. But to access the clues, they must first answer questions with a very particular characteristic: the answer is always a letter.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Bêtes De Film Ep.6: Eyes All Around
programme.desc: The team resorts to countless tricks to achieve its goals, especially when it comes to making flies mate in front of the camera! Jean doubles his efforts to convince Taj the tiger to leap over an obstacle.

programme.title: Les Belges Du Bout Du Monde
programme.desc: Belgians who achieved their dreams, sometimes by chance, sometimes by necessity. A series that presents the personal portraits and fascinating lives of Belgians who settled in different regions around the globe.

programme.title: Gigantosaurus Ep.37: Jugglers For A Day, Jugglers Forever
programme.desc: Four little dinosaurs, Rocky, Bill, Tiny and Mazu, discover a dangerous world where the mysterious Gigantosaurus, the most ferocious of all the dinosaurs, is forever on the prowl. The four best friends set their heading for adventure, confronting their fears and working together to solve all their problems.

programme.title: Idéfix Et Les Irréductibles Ep.3: Huffing isn't playing fair
programme.desc: 52 before JC. The city of Lutecia is occupied by the Romans... Completely? No! A gang of invincible animals led by Idéfix resist the invader again and again and its plans to romanise the city.

programme.title: Les Quiquoi Ep.15: The strange witch
programme.desc: Olive, Pétole, Boulard, Mixo, Raoul and Pamela make up a full-of-fun gang known as the Quiquoi. Together they ask a host of existential questions, using drawings to find the answers. In their own quirky way, they love nothing better than creating surrealist worlds where everything becomes possible.

programme.title: Rocky & Lily : C'Est Dans La Boîte ! Ep.17: Summer sports
programme.desc: Every day, Rocky and Lily receive a new box on the set. But what does it contain? It's always a surprising object that leads them to discover very different subjects: turtles, bowling or even cloud formation.

programme.title: Drazilion Ep.16: Who grumbles last, grumbles the best
programme.desc: In a world full of mysterious creatures, Oli, Emma, Fabio and Rachel set off on a hunt for Drazilion, the mother creature of Virmark. Their goal: free Captain Goulache from the bad curse put on him, while avoiding the Vikings who are trying to put spokes in their wheel.

programme.title: Tout Le Monde Veut Prendre Sa Place
programme.desc: The game where everyone wants to be a winner. One quiz, six candidates and, comfortably installed in his chair, one champion... whom everyone dreams of unseating!

programme.title: Un Si Grand Soleil
programme.desc: The Bastide, Estrela, Salama, Lévy, Berville and Alami families, plus a host of supporting characters, live and work in the modern everyday city of Montpellier, in southern France. Between romance and crime thriller, with a blend of comic and serious themes, their stories weave a fascinating web.

programme.title: Championnat Du Monde Des Tracassets 2026
programme.desc: Have you heard of tracassets? Part farm tractor, part moped, these quirky machines weave their way along the paths of the Lavaux vineyards in the canton of Vaud in pursuit of speed. And every two years, they go head-to-head in a world championship where anything goes, as long as it rolls. Épesses is hosting the 24thth edition.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Le Grand Cactus Ep.8: Benny B
programme.desc: For the holidays, a special edition with an exceptional guest: Benny B, one of the legends of rap and French-speaking hip hop culture. Also: the traditional King's speech and segments featuring emblematic Christmas characters.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.32: René Pierre games tables/Nicolas Jurnjack hairstylist
programme.desc: Pool, table football... In France, René Pierre is the benchmark manufacturer for games tables. All about the bistro, everyday symbol of popular gastronomy. Encounter with Nicolas Jurnjack: when styling hair is also an opportunity for creativity and expression in the world of fashion. How to wear a corset.

programme.title: Festival D'Angoulême - Cérémonie De Clôture
programme.desc: Closing ceremony of the Francophone Film Festival in Angoulême.

programme.title: La Faune Connectée Ep.4: On the trail of invertebrates
programme.desc: Kathleen MacGregor is conducting a three-year study of invertebrates in the St. Lawrence River, by fitting 200 transmitters on six species, including green sea urchins and common crabs. Her team assesses the impact of human activities on this aquatic ecosystem at the Maurice-Lamontagne Institute.

programme.title: The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won’t find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today’s world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
